rca_of_the_issue: The prior behavior baked show_title.image into shows.image and the RDS resolver preferred templates over per-show images. The tested fix removes create/recurrence-time template image copying and changes resolver priority to shows.image first, then show_titles.image fallback, then cached rundown image. No MOCKED APIs were used.
